design_note: Shows the lost-continuation gap between a saved run and a queue publish. The paired crash traces isolate what committing an outbox record adds, while retaining duplicate-delivery and external-effect limits.

source.title: Transactional outbox pattern
source.concept: Persisting the state change and an outgoing event in one database transaction leaves recoverable publication work after a crash. Relays can publish duplicates, so consumers still need idempotent handling.
source.scope: Original INC-93 crash traces; assumes a durable atomic database transaction, a recovering relay and stable consumer deduplication.

lesson.title: Save the next obligation with the state
lesson.intro: AegisOps saves INC-93 after gathering evidence, then must schedule hypothesis work. Compare a crash at the same point: after committing local state but before queue publication.

data.input: INC-93: evidence ready; hypothesis step must be scheduled

left.title: Separate state and send
left.result: Continuation can be lost without a separate repair scan.

right.title: State plus outbox
steps: Relay recovers H-93 and publishes it
right.result: Durable scheduling obligation survives; duplicates possible.

read: Both traces lose the worker before any queue publication.
The right transaction stores the pending message alongside the state.
A relay repairs delivery; the consumer still deduplicates event H-93.
lesson.question: If the relay publishes H-93 and crashes before marking it sent, what must the consumer tolerate?
lesson.answer: A repeat delivery of H-93. The relay may publish again because its local record is still pending. The consumer needs a durable idempotent handling contract for that event. This scheduling mechanism does not establish permission for a rollback or guarantee a single external effect; those retain their separate authority and operation contracts.
lesson.takeaway: Commit the next scheduling obligation with progress, then make its delivery safe to repeat.
lesson.assumption: Fictional crash traces; the left design has no repair scan. The right relay eventually runs; consumer deduplication remains necessary.
